title: Gloamfall - a pixel-art dark-fantasy roguelike
author: Open_Newspaper9641
selftext:
Im stoked to announce that Gloamfall is out now on Steam! 👑

(Video Trailer is Outdated, game looks, feels and is better in all the ways possible, i'll make soon a new video!)

Go grab your copy and enjoy a well made game, all my 17 years of experience are there, you will have a blast 100% if you like Roguelikes and RPGs. ⚔



Thank you so much! If you like it dont hesitate and leave me a Review! 🤝

Much Love 🥰

Rafa from FormulasGames 🎮



Steam Page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371080/Gloamfall/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371080/Gloamfall/)

comments.body:
Hey u/Open_Newspaper9641, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
